title: Useful Machinery Runner Agent-Login Readiness V1
description: Each provider's readiness on a runner and the record of what the runner installed. It holds no login material.

installable.description: A coding agent whose login a runner installs. A provider other than claude_code and codex, and its state, are a newer runner's, which an older runner keeps as written.

selected.description: Whether the provider was selected, which an earlier release wrote; nothing reads it, and the runner writes it on no entry.

lastUse.description: How the provider answered the last use of the login installed: accepted when an agent step that received its variable finished successfully, refused when one failed with the harness error unauthorized. Recorded only beside an install, with when.

source.description: Where the coding agent's login comes from, as the setup pass that wrote the entry settled it: host while the service has a login of its own, grant while the runner keeps one it offers. Absent while neither provides one.

brokered.description: An OAuth provider whose token Cloud issues for each assignment: what the last assignment the runner admitted was issued, its run and, once it has ended, when, never the token or the path of its file. A provider the runner has asked for no token of, one the host provides included, is not_delivered.

grantId.description: The grant a ready token was issued from.

connectionAuthorizationId.description: The connection authorization a ready github token was issued under, in place of a grant: the organization's GitHub App installation an owner authorized for the run.

selected.description: Whether the provider was selected, which an earlier release wrote; nothing reads it, and the runner writes it on no entry.

runId.description: The run of the assignment the entry was recorded for. An entry recorded before runs were has none.

endedAt.description: When that assignment ended on this runner; absent while it runs.

source.description: Where the provider's credential came from for that assignment, as its admission settled it: host while the service environment carries the provider's names, grant while the admission holds a token issued from a grant it can read back, org_connection, on github's entry alone, while it holds one issued under a connection authorization. Absent while neither provides one. A token issued later in the run under another grant or authorization leaves it as it was.
